events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, a field in upstate New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. Three days of peace, love, and music. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the music world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we said goodbye to the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shape music and culture. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, dying six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, hip-hop lost one of its most influential voices. Remembering the unparalleled impact of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true guitar icon. Jimi Hendrix's innovation and influence remain unmatched. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those tracks. Pure genius. Which side are you playing first?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, born in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking with The Pretenders and forever a legend.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: LG's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced its revolutionary first-generation iPod, changing how we listen to music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Tech Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod. Suddenly, a thousand songs in your pocket was a reality. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! More than six decades of iconic espionage, gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon, born in 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking double album 'The Beatles', commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. An eclectic masterpiece. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen in music history. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
